entities.name: Arasta
entities.description: A gigantic humanoid spider of Theros, once a dryad under Nylea's care, warped by Phenax.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of Theros who treated the dryad Arasta as a sister and later drove her away.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: Envious god who warped Arasta into a monstrous spider.

entities.name: Enorasi
entities.description: A gnarled olive tree deep within the Nessian Wood where Arasta makes her lair; it grants visions of the future or madness.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: Forest of Theros that holds Enorasi.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God who planted the tree Enorasi.

events.summary: Phenax warps the beloved dryad Arasta into a monstrous spider.
events.quote: She was warped into a monstrous spider creature by the envious god Phenax
Horrified by the unfamiliar creature, Nylea drove Arasta away.

events.summary: Arasta makes her home in the olive tree Enorasi in the Nessian Wood.
events.quote: Arasta made her home in the gnarled olive tree Enorasi, deep within the Nessian Wood

relations.note: Arasta was once a dryad under Nylea's care, treated as a sister.
relations.quote: Arasta was originally a beloved dryad under Nylea 's care, who treated her as a sister.

relations.note: Phenax warped her into a monster out of envy.
relations.quote: She was warped into a monstrous spider creature by the envious god Phenax

relations.note: The tree stands deep within the wood.
